editorial:
Imagine you are at a fancy wedding in Mexico City, surrounded by rich people and luxury. Suddenly, everything goes wrong when a massive riot breaks out right outside the gates. You get to see how quickly a perfect day turns into a nightmare as the military takes over and the rich family realizes their world is flipping upside down. The mood is tense and uncomfortable, making you feel the panic of the characters as they try to find a missing bride while the city burns around them.

What really hits hard is the acting; the actors make you feel the fear and desperation in every scene. The pacing starts slow but gets much more intense as the plot twists. While some parts might feel too mean or sad for some, it is a powerful look at how people treat each other when power changes hands. If you want a movie that makes you think, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie ends on a dark note. You find out that the bride was captured by the poor people who were rioting. Instead of being rescued by the military, she is treated like a prisoner. The roles are completely reversed, and the rich family has no power left to save her. It ends with the realization that the new system is just as cruel as the old one, leaving the characters in a hopeless situation.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about social collapse and intense psychological drama.
